messages:
olivia_prodsec: heads up — the apac TLS profile rollout is causing intermittent handshakes from edge -> internal-proxy. seeing lots of `tls: handshake failure` in proxy logs after the new cipher list landed. :rotating_light:

mike_sec: ouch. any KMS errors in the cert rotator?

olivia_prodsec: yes — cert-rotator failing to unwrap private keys. sample from cert-rotator logs:
```
2026-04-10T04:23:11Z ERROR: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Requestor not authorized to use key versions
request: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/certs/cryptoKeys/edge-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1
service_account: cert-rotator-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

jane_infra: that looks like an IAM change. we rolled a least-privilege tweak last night for cloudkms roles. suspect the cert-rotator SA lost `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.accessAsymmetricDecrypt` / decrypt permissions.

tom_sre: confirmed in audit logs — 04:22:59 UTC there was an `iam.bind` that removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from `infra-deploy` group for apac. audit id: 0x7f9b2c.

ben_platform: if rotator can't decrypt keys, proxy will try new certs but can't load private key => handshake fail. mitigation options: revert TLS profile on proxy (quick) or grant a temporary IAM allow to cert-rotator SA (safer for certs). which do we prefer? :thinking_face:

olivia_prodsec: prefer grant short-lived IAM while we validate. revert TLS profile will require a deploy and could impact in-flight sessions.

mike_sec: agree. steps I propose:
1) add temporary conditional binding for `cert-rotator-sa@...` to `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` scoped to the apac key ring for 1 hour.
2) run cert-rotator retry job manually and confirm keys unwrap.
3) revert iam change in infra group and re-run tests.
4) create runbook entry and add an automated alert if decrypt fails 3x in 5m.

jane_infra: I can push the temporary binding now. will also capture the exact audit entries for forensic. ping me if you want me to apply with a short TTL via gcloud iam policy binding + conditional expr.

olivia_prodsec: please do and paste the command here.

jane_infra: running:
```
gcloud iam roles add-iam-policy-binding --project=redwood-prod \
  --member=serviceAccount:cert-rotator-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \
  --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp(\"2026-04-10T05:30:00Z\"),title=temporary_rotator_allow"
```
Applied. audit entry: `iam.serviceAccount.setIamPolicy` 04:27:03 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy: cert-rotator retry job queued by jane_infra — job id: retry-20260410-01.

tom_sre: retry job finished. cert-rotator logs now show successful unwrap and provision: `unwrap ok, installed 3 certs` at 04:30:12 UTC. proxy handshakes recovery trending up.

mike_sec: great. follow-ups:
- add an automated IAM smoke test in the canary pipeline that attempts a KMS decrypt using the rotator SA before we change kms-related bindings centrally. keeps rollouts safe.
- update the rollback playbook with explicit RBAC checklist and KMS audit query snippet.

olivia_prodsec: I'll draft the playbook update. can someone add the KMS audit query? I use this to fetch relevant entries:
```
resource.type="audited_resource"
protoPayload.serviceName="iam.googleapis.com"
protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy"
resource.labels.project_id="redwood-prod"
protoPayload.request.policy.bindings.members:"cert-rotator-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
"cloudkms" OR "cryptoKey"
```

ben_platform: added to runbook and created a ticket: RNW-4821 — "TLS profile rollout: RBAC and KMS prechecks". I'll own the automation spike for the smoke test.

jane_infra: we also need to check GKE node pools in apac where the proxy runs — there was a config sync that updated `ssl_cipher_suites` in the sidecar config. rolling back just the cipher list is an option if we see persistent failures after restoring KMS access.

mike_sec: long-term fixes:
- improve RBAC change process: any change that touches `cloudkms` or `roles/cloudkms.*` must run the new smoke test and wait for green before merge.
- add alerting on `PermissionDenied` from kms paths with high cardinality to catch cross-region regressions.
- tighten IAM change approval flow in PagerDuty for infra group binding changes.

olivia_prodsec: tagging sec-eng on follow-ups. thanks all — marking incident as mitigated pending a postmortem. :white_check_mark:

tom_sre: will kick off postmortem doc and include timeline, audit ids, and the temporary binding TTL.

deploy-bot: incident: RNW-2026-04-10-01 CLOSED by olivia_prodsec at 2026-04-10T05:35:00Z

olivia_prodsec: postmortem action items assigned in RNW-4821, will review in next weekly sec-eng sync.
